SUMMARY OF THE
FINAL ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT STATEMENT
PREPARED BY THE
OFFICE OF AUTOMOTIVE FUEL ECONOMY

NATIONAL HIGHWAY TRAFFIC SAFETY ADMINISTRATION
1. <u>Title of Action</u>: Average Fuel Economy Standard for Nonpassenger Automobiles, Model Year 1979. (This is an administrative action.)
2. <u>Description of Action</u>: This action is the promulgation of an average fuel economy standard (AFES) for nonpassenger automobiles (NPA's) not more than 6,000 pounds gross vehicle weight rating (GVWR), which are manufactured in mcdel year (MY) 1979. Vehicles such as vans, pickup trucks, and general utility vehicles (jeeps and other off-road vehicles), not more than 6,000 pounds GVWR are affected. The final AFES has not been established since the comments to the Notice of Proposed Rulemaking (NPRM) for the AFES have not been fully analyzed. The primary issues yet to be resolved are the fuel economy penalty of the proposed MY 1979 emission standard and test procedure changes as described in the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Revised Light Duty Truck Regulation for 1979 and Later Hodel Years (40 FR 56316, December 28,
